## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] User-visible changes add a fragment in `changelog.d/` (see [changelog.d/README.md](https://github.com/yuraware/lagom/blob/main/changelog.d/README.md)), or the change needs none.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the [contributing guide](https://github.com/yuraware/lagom/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#dependencies) explains why it is allowed.
- [ ] Text shown to the model follows the [review checklist](https://github.com/yuraware/lagom/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#review-checklist-text-lagom-shows-to-the-model).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see [Sign your work](https://github.com/yuraware/lagom/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-your-work).
